items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Fade Marble. And the extra band

ctx.x: Fade Marble. And the extra band, uh, that, uh, it used to be that, uh, you had a club and you'd hire, you know, extra bands to play that. And then, uh, it would be continuous dancing. That's when I was a kid.
But you don't remember whose band it was?
